_doc: Per-file occurrence-count ratchet for direct project.design_doc and project.directions assignments. Read by TestDesignDocLockInvariant and TestDirectionsLockInvariant in test_invariants.py. Counts should only decrease over time as write sites are migrated to canonical helpers (with_design_doc_locked / with_directions_locked in task_locking.py). Never increase a count — that widens the tripwire hole. When a site is migrated to the canonical helper, lower the count by 1. Remove the entry when the count reaches 0.
